status: Exact analysis specification before examination of new spectral association and brightness outcomes. Catalogue counts and spectrum coverage already known.
index_quality: MPA reliable=1, finite measurement and positive standard error; Dn4000 positive. Independently integrated bands require >=90% unmasked coverage and positive means.
associations: Within each age catalogue collapse repeated physical hosts; raw Spearman and partial Spearman conditioning on ranked host mass and redshift. Bootstrap physical hosts, 2000 draws.
brightness_cohort: Previously defined 401 TITAN-ZTF sample intersected with unique reliable spectra and both valid Dn4000 and Hdelta; same cohort for every nested model.
brightness_models: nonlinear SALT + soft mass step + local g-z + linear redshift
base + continuous TITAN mass + Av + metallicity
uncertainties: Primary conditions on SED medians and measured index values; sensitivity adds independent propagated Dn4000/Hdelta errors, not a full latent spectral likelihood. SALT covariance and nuisance-dependent variance preserved. Five physical-host folds with seed above; heldout log scores include fitted coefficient covariance. Bootstrap heldout scores conditional on fitted folds.
dust: Halpha,Hbeta,OIII5007,NII6584 each S/N>3; Kauffmann BPT starforming cut logOIII/Hbeta < .61/(logNII/Halpha-.05)+1.3 and logNII/Halpha<.05. Intrinsic Balmer decrement2.86 and F99Rv3.1 only explicit conditional conversion, never SN dust.
aperture: SDSS fibre diameter3arcsec; MaNGA central3arcsec vs1Re elliptical shell, not integrated total. Fiducial Om.3,H0=70 only for aperture kpc; not new cosmological inference.
